```{=html}
<style>
  .avatar-wrapper {
    position: relative;
    display: inline-block;
    aspect-ratio: 1 / 1;
    border-radius: 50%;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .avatar-wrapper img {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
    transition: opacity 0.4s ease;
  }
  .avatar-hover {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    opacity: 0;
  }
  .avatar-wrapper.active .avatar-default { opacity: 0; }
  .avatar-wrapper.active .avatar-hover   { opacity: 1; }
</style>
<script>
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
    const base = document.querySelector("img.about-image");
    if (!base) return;

    // Wrap the existing image
    const wrapper = document.createElement("div");
    wrapper.className = "avatar-wrapper";
    base.classList.add("avatar-default");
    base.parentNode.insertBefore(wrapper, base);
    wrapper.appendChild(base);

    // Overlay the hover image
    const hover = document.createElement("img");
    hover.src = base.src.replace("profile.png", "profile-hover.png");
    hover.className = "avatar-hover";
    hover.alt = "";
    wrapper.appendChild(hover);

    // Desktop
    wrapper.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => wrapper.classList.add("active"));
    wrapper.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => wrapper.classList.remove("active"));

    // Mobile touch — tap to toggle
    wrapper.addEventListener("touchstart", (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      wrapper.classList.toggle("active");
    }, { passive: false });

    // Photo credit below the name
    const h1 = document.querySelector("#quarto-content h1");
    if (h1) {
      const credit = document.createElement("p");
      credit.innerHTML = 'Credit to not-so-secret photo: <a href="https://instagram.com/taiwanjoe" target="_blank" rel="noopener">@taiwanjoe</a>';
      credit.style.cssText = "font-size:0.75rem; color: #888; margin-top:0.15rem;";
      h1.insertAdjacentElement("afterend", credit);
    }
  });
</script>
```

I previously served as a public affairs officer with experience in military strategic communications—press releases, print materials, and digital content. I’ve worked with journalists and other communicators to explain defense policy clearly and credibly.

I also study the PRC’s influence operations and information warfare, with a focus on disinformation, narrative strategy, and how public perception shifts in high-stakes geopolitical environments.

📢 Pronounced [Shàoyì](https://voca.ro/12SteQV3fTDZ) (Shao-yee). Feel free to call me Yee if that’s easier.

### Education

-   National Defense University, Taipei, Taiwan — M.A. in Journalism, Aug. 2014–Jun. 2016

-   National Defense University, Taipei, Taiwan — B.A. in Journalism, Jan. 2008–Jun. 2012

-   **Su-Yu Chou, Shao-Yi Lai**. 2015. “The influence of virtual presence—Internet word-of-mouth and the image of the army in disaster relief.” [*The Third Military News Forum*](https://gpi.culture.tw/books/1010402118).
